\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & -1 & 2 \\ -1 & 1 & 2 & 0 \\ -1 & 2 & 1 & -5\end{array}\right]

$R_3:=R_3+(1)R_1$.

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -3\end{array}\right]
$$

The second pivot is zero, while the third row has a nonzero second entry. Exchange $R_2$ and $R_3$.

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 2\end{array}\right]
$$

Thus the row echelon matrix is

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 2\end{array}\right]
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}z &=2 \\ y &=-3-(0)(2) \\ &=-3 \\ x &=2-(-1)(-3) \\ &\quad -(-1)(2) \\ &=1\end{aligned}
